entradas.text: "That's relieving to hear. I thought you forgot about all the other issues."
She sighed and looked outside the window for a moment.
"Can you explain me one thing. How come you think that the Supreme Court's right to vote on constitutional amendments is a major problem with such priority?"
"To further the reforms."
entradas.menu: "To further the reforms."

entradas.text: "To ensure the new processes are respected and executed in transparency."
entradas.menu: "To ensure the new processes are respected and executed in transparency."

entradas.text: "Focus on our internal and external threats."
entradas.menu: "Focus on our internal and external threats."

entradas.text: "We will eliminate the Old Guards from all branches of government."
entradas.menu: "We will eliminate the Old Guards from all branches of government."

entradas.text: "...What will be your next move?"
"I thought we wer-"
She sighed and looked outside the window for a moment.
"Of course."
"That point was a red line for Mr. Ricter. We had to include it."
entradas.menu: "That point was a red line for Mr. Ricter. We had to include it."

entradas.text: "Mr. President!"
"I see."
"I'm asking the President, Mrs. Morgna."
"Of course."
"You shouldn't make a move against the Court, Mr. President."
"How can I be sure that you will not go after us too?"
"Trust me. It is only the Old Guard we're after."
entradas.menu: "Trust me. It is only the Old Guard we're after."

entradas.text: She sighed and looked outside the window for a moment.
"Help me bring Orso Hawker down. He's the only one we need."
entradas.menu: "Help me bring Orso Hawker down. He's the only one we need."

entradas.text: "I'm sorry?"
"We can't do anything without a proper cause anyway."
entradas.menu: "We can't do anything without a proper cause anyway."

entradas.text: "Mrs. Edmonds... Mr. President had a rough day. This court vote is extremely important for us. Please do understand our position."
"Mrs. Edmonds, we are not against you. We want you on our side."
"I don't know what to say, Mr. President..."
Nia looked really worried and tense.
Isabel took another sip from her water and looked at me without saying anything.
"I did not intend any offence, Mrs. Edmonds. Please accept my apology."
entradas.menu: "I did not intend any offense, Mrs. Edmonds. Please accept my apology."

entradas.text: "Mrs. Edmonds, please help us achieve this victory. We have to be together in this."
entradas.menu: "Mrs. Edmonds, please help us achieve this victory. We have to be together in this."

entradas.text: "What do you want in return for the centrist vote?"
entradas.menu: "What do you want in return for the centrist vote?"

entradas.text: "Mrs. Edmonds, how about we get to the point now?"
entradas.menu: "Mrs. Edmonds, how about we get to the point now?"

entradas.text: "I don't want anything, Mr. President..."
"Let's just get to the point, Mrs. Edmonds. Do I have your vote or not?"
entradas.menu: "Let's just get to the point, Mrs. Edmonds. Do I have your vote or not?"

entradas.text: "I told you. You are not our target."
entradas.menu: "I told you. You are not our target."

entradas.text: "Just because your *corruption* police put some pressure on the Court, doesn't mean you own it now."
She sighed.
"Interesting. So you do not own it up, after all."
"I just want assurance that you don't intend to destroy the Court."
"Why don't you ask the *reformists*? This proposal was made together."
entradas.menu: "Why don't you ask the *reformists*? This proposal was made together."

entradas.text: "Isn't that where we are?"
"The judiciary should not have legislative powers, Mrs. Edmonds."
entradas.menu: "The judiciary should not have legislative powers, Mrs. Edmonds."

entradas.text: "Perhaps that is the way we must take..."
"I did not intend any offence, Mrs. Edmonds. Please accept my apology."
entradas.menu: "I did not intend any offense, Mrs. Edmonds. Please accept my apology."

entradas.text: "My vote is not for sale."
"You heard me."
entradas.menu: "You heard me."

entradas.text: "I hope so."
"How can we even do that? Please, Mrs. Edmonds. Don't overexaggerate."
entradas.menu: "How can we even do that? Please, Mrs. Edmonds. Don't overexaggerate."

entradas.text: "You have my word."
entradas.menu: "You have my word."

entradas.text: "I didn't want to disrespect you, Mrs. Edmonds."
entradas.menu: "I didn't want to disrespect you, Mrs. Edmonds."

entradas.text: "Of course not..."
"With all due respect, you are reaching the last straw."
entradas.menu: "With all due respect, you are reaching the last straw."

entradas.text: "The Court has been stopping every constitutional change, Mrs. Edmonds..."
entradas.menu: "The Court has been stopping every constitutional change, Mrs. Edmonds..."

entradas.text: "I didn't come here to be disrespected, Mr. President."
"That's not very relieving."
"So that is your position... I see."
"Why don't you ask the *reformists*? That clause was one of their main demands too."
entradas.menu: "Why don't you ask the *reformists*? That clause was one of their main demands too."

entradas.text: "That point was a red line for the opposition. We had to include it."
entradas.menu: "That point was a red line for the opposition. We had to include it."
